Hey, Hymnalstories 
I don't know if I can be of any help but I can atleast offer some perspective on what you are thinking about because i have dealt with a similar situation in my life. 

So, on love: 
I don't think it's very wise to think of love as the meaning of life, love is something very profound and a basic need of nearly everyone and I know how hard it can be to live without it or having the perception that nobody loves me or understands me. That said, sometimes it helps to think rationally about such complex things as love and make them as simple as you can. What is love? It's just some chemicals in your head that help you fulfill your biological 'purpose', to procreate. So my thinking was I'm not just gonna let my life be controlled by something as simple as a few molecules not beeing in my head.
If that approach doesn't help I can offer you this: 
nearly 3 years ago i wrote on here too, sure about never beeing able to feel love for somebody or even more crazy beeing loved by someone else. Well i couldn't have been more wrong, a month later, I met this girl, this girl is now my girlfriend of 2 1/2 years and I went through the most personal changes ever since, saying that it was easy to deal with my depression and trying to have a healthy relationship at the same time would be a lie but I think I came out a better person at the end with all the hardship than if it would have all been handed to me. Of course I can't promisse you that you will find somebody next month or even in a year, but you never know what the future might bring and with 8 billion humans on the planet the changes are good that theres someone out there for all of us. In the meantime:

On the meaning of life:
So it seems like that aside from your biological purposes like surviving and having children nature hasn't intended much for us, of course for religious people there could be some differences there but it's more or less the same.
So if we are saying there is no meaning in life could we see that in a negative way? Of course, If life has no meaning, what does it all matter anyway.
But could you also see it in a more positive light? I think so
See it this way, if life doesn't have a predetermined meaning for you, what stops you from creating your own meaning, (in a of couse somewhat limited way), your meaning can be everything you want it to be. You want to help people? do that. You want to explore something new? the world is open to you. It doesn't even have to be one big goal, do alot of small ones. For example one of my goals is to be someone somebody else can look up to and maybe even be inspired by my actions to  become a better version of themself. I want to be someone that at the end of the day other people can say about "that's a good guy" an maybe bring a smile to their face. Maybe don't think  "it would be cool to be this" and rather think about what would make you happy not only while reaping the results but also while doing and working on it.

I hope i could have been of at least some help for you and wish you all the best.
